conviction_note: The findings net to zero: Q1 progress of 38% of the H1 operating-profit plan is behind the company's own 42-52% history and Seven-Eleven's summer traffic was weak, but both are public, and against them sit falling 2026-crop rice prices and possible fire-insurance income. abs_move is raised to 4.0 from the 2.12 proxy because the company has revised its full-year forecast at every H1 print since 2022 and moved -9.6% and +17.0% on the last two. p_up 47 is a faint lean down, so the scaled number (-0.24) and the findings sum (0.0) differ only by that lean.
bar: Company H1 (Mar-Aug) plan: net sales 121,500m yen, operating profit 4,350m (-17.8% YoY), ordinary 4,350m, net 2,700m; full year OP 7,700m, unchanged at Q1 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260707/140120260706588141.pdf). No sourced H1 consensus. Fisco on 2026-07-08 said the full-year market consensus sits ABOVE the company plan, with no number given (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=2918&b=n202607080431). The bar is the company plan plus an unquantified street number above it, so every size is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register as of 2026-09-29: 0.0%, no disclosed position at or above 0.5%, change 0.0 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). Margin ratio (信用倍率) 14.8x, a crowded leveraged retail long, confirmed on kabutan's quote page 2026-10-07 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=2918). No skew exists. Run-up -5.16% over 20 days and -2.11% over 5. The price of 2,645 is back at the level it held after the Q1 drop (2,618-2,638 on 07-08/09), and the stock went ex the 60-yen H1 dividend at the end of August.

findings.finding: Q1 OP of 1,653m is 38.0% of the 4,350m H1 plan. The company's Q1 share of actual H1 OP in the last three years was about 52% (FY25), 42% (FY26) and ~49% (FY24). Meeting the plan needs Q2 OP of 2,697m (-11% YoY) after Q1 fell 26.4%. On historical seasonality H1 comes in at roughly 3.2-3.9bn, a 10-25% miss, unless the product-spec improvements (+22.8億 delivered in Q1 against +50.7億 planned for H1) ramp up in Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At the Q1 print (2026-07-07) Fisco flagged the slow progress against the H1 plan and the stock fell 2689 -> 2638 (-1.9%) the next day, then rallied to 2,877 by late August. The estimated H1-print reactions were -9.61% (2024-10) and +17.01% (2025-10).
findings.source_date: 2026-10-07 (page fetched; Q1 data from the 2026-07-07 短信)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. Anyone can compute this progress rate from the Q1 短信, and Fisco wrote it up on 07-08. The part that may not be priced is the comparison with the company's own Q1 share, which is lower than in any of the last three years. Had the market fully discounted a 10-25% H1 miss, the stock would trade below its post-Q1 low of 2,618; it is at 2,645 with margin longs at 14.8x, so holders are leveraged long.
findings.independence: Q1 補足資料 bridge: raw materials -23.6億 and Sapporo shutdown -2.6億 in Q1 alone (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260707/140120260706588113.pdf). Same company documents, so this is not independent.

findings.finding: Seven-Eleven Japan, the dominant customer, posted flat-to-tiny same-store sales through the peak summer quarter (June 0.0%, July +0.6%, August +0.3%) with customer counts down 3.5%, 2.2% and 1.9%. That gives no volume tailwind for Warabeya's Q2 against last year's strong 3,042m Q2 OP. Lawson's August was +1.5% with customers +0.6%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No direct record of this stock reacting to a customer-traffic miss. Q1 food sales were +1.3%, against similarly flat 7-Eleven same-store sales.
findings.why_not_priced: The 7-Eleven monthly is public and widely read, so this is a proxy that is largely priced. It is filed because Warabeya's Q2 sales need +1.6% YoY to hit the plan and the customer's traffic says volume did not help.
findings.independence: Lawson August +1.5% / customers +0.6%, a different chain: https://www.ryutsuu.biz/sales/s091078.html

findings.finding: Japanese rice prices are turning down for the 2026 crop: JA Kagoshima's early-season suggested price is about 20% lower, and Seven-Eleven, Lawson and FamilyMart announced onigiri price cuts from September. The company's plan books a -36.3億 raw-material headwind for H2, so falling rice gives room to hold or firm the full-year guide at this print. Lower selling prices pass part of the gain through.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At the 2025-10 H1 print the company raised its full-year NI (39->54億) and the stock moved about +17% (estimated date). At the 2024-10 H1 print it revised and the stock moved -9.6%. Guidance is the line this stock moves on at H1.
findings.why_not_priced: This is macro-to-company transmission that the company has not yet confirmed. The FY27 plan was set in April at peak 2025-crop rice costs, and the Q1 materials still describe raw materials as the main drag. If the market had priced H2 cost relief, the stock would have held the late-August 2,870s instead of sliding back to the post-Q1 level.
findings.independence: nippon.com/Jiji (2026-07-16) on new-crop rice prices seen falling after a two-year rise; the URL returned 404 on fetch, so it is snippet_only. The plan's H2 raw-material line of -36.3億 is from https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260707/140120260706588113.pdf.

findings.finding: The Sapporo plant fire of 2026-02-16 cost a 566m special loss in FY26. The company insures against fire, and the 2026-05-27 third report said the insurer's payout was still undetermined, so any recognised insurance receipt would arrive as special income below operating profit, possibly in H1.
findings.why_not_priced: The amount and timing are undisclosed, so no number can be priced. It is a one-off below OP with no path to the OP guide, sized at a fraction.
findings.independence: FY26 短信 shows 火災損失 566m: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260408/140120260407599767.pdf

findings.finding: The company has revised its full-year forecast at the H1 print in each of the last four years (修 dated 22/10/07, 23/10/06, 24/10/08, 25/10/07 on kabutan's revision history). Its H1 results beat the initial H1 plan in FY24 (4,491 vs 3,650) and FY26 (5,289 vs 3,800). A revision at this print is likely and its sign is open, so this sets scale, not direction.
findings.why_not_priced: The direction cannot be priced in advance. The magnitude is not in the 2.12% proxy, which mixes in the small Q1/Q3/full-year reactions.
findings.independence: The 2025-10 upward revision is confirmed by SBBIT/Monex snippets (https://www.sbbit.jp/article/refers/172902).

outside_window.finding: Seven & i's own H1 results and Seven-Eleven Japan's September same-store sales would show customer margin and pricing pressure on vendors, but both are expected after 2026-10-08.

baseline_tension: The baseline lean is -0.33 (crowded margin long, mild negative run-up), and my small negatives agree with it, so they add little. The strongest positive this release could carry is a held or raised full-year guide on falling rice costs, as in October 2025's +17% reaction. I looked for it and filed it at +0.5. The net is about zero.
lessons_applied: Rule 1: the progress-rate negative (finding 1) rests on a number anyone can compute from the Q1 短信, so it was cut from -0.8 to -0.5 and p_up moved from 44 to 47. The release may add a forecast revision, but its sign is open.
Rule 1: the 7-Eleven monthly negative (finding 2) is a public series, cut from -0.4 to -0.2.
Rule 2: I wrote down the strongest positive (a held or raised guide on rice relief) and confirmed I had looked for it (finding 3), so it left that finding unchanged.
The scale finding (finding 5), the insurance one-off (finding 4) and abs_move_pct 4.0 were left standing.
